maya: quick heads up — nightly kernel-prober (ampere / midseq path) flagged a ~9% median latency regression for candidate-kernel v3.2 (autotune pick).
perf-bot: nightly-probe finished: job=prober-ampere-midseq-3112, delta=+9.3% p50, p95 +12%. https://ci.internal/redwood/job/3112 :warning:
raj: oof. which path? kv-cache or batching heuristics?
maya: looks related to the kv-prefill path when seqlen ~512 and batch size >8. microbench below.
maya: ```
# kbench diff (baseline -> candidate-v3.2)
# arch=ampere seqlen=512 batch=12 iters=50
baseline p50=1.23ms p95=2.10ms
candidate p50=1.35ms p95=2.36ms
delta p50=+9.8% p95=+12.4%
# notes: gcopies increased, memcpy time up ~18%
```
hao: can you capture perf map / flame? i want to see if it's memory stalls or tensor-core fallback.
maya: uploading perf flame to s3: s3://perf/ampere/3112/maya-flame.svg
maya: quick grep on perf shows L1d_load_stalls +25% and memcpy hotspots in prefill path.
raj: suspect autotune chose a variant that uses indirect loads / scatter-gather for KV prefill. that can hit cache + memcpy if layout not contiguous.
maya: autotune did pick kernel 'matmul_indirect_opt' for midseq. that one improved longseq on other archs but might be bad for kv-prefill strided layouts.
jen: easy triage: run differential microprobe baseline vs candidate with KV prefill disabled, and with layout forced to 'continuous' to see if regression is layout-sensitive.
perf-bot: scheduled differential job: prober-diff-3112-1 (baseline vs candidate, kv-disabled) https://ci.internal/redwood/job/3112/diff-1
hao: also try `--force-layout=continuous` and `--kvcopy-method=old` to isolate memmove path. if that removes delta kernel is guilty.
maya: queued both. early results: with KV disabled, delta goes away (p50 diff ~+0.5%). with force-layout=continuous candidate matches baseline.
raj: that pretty much pins it to the KV layout interaction. looks like candidate's prefill code path does an extra bufferization and memcpy.
irene: we should gate the candidate in autotune for seqlen range 256-1024 on ampere until we fix it. also add a KV-heavy trace to nightly so this doesn't slip.
maya: agreed. next steps: 1) open rollback PR to disable candidate-v3.2 for ampere midseq range 2) add KV-heavy trace to nightly prober 3) root-cause kernel code path and revert the indirect load change or add layout-aware fastpath.
jen: can we hotfix the autotune policy instead of a full code revert? i.e., prefer matmul_contig for seqlen 256..1024 on ampere.
maya: yes i'll push an autotune policy PR (w/ test) as a fast rollback and follow up with kernel patch.
irene: owning infra part: i'll add trace -> nightly and increase run count to reduce noise. assigning to maya for PR + triage.
maya: taking ownership. ETA: will run more microprobes and open PR by EOD. leaving notes in the prober ticket.
jen: thanks maya. keep us posted. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: note: flakiness observed (2/3 runs fail) — queued additional 5 runs to get stable median.
maya: ack, will wait for stable numbers before merging rollback.
